lines.en: I show up at the gym for morning soccer practice to find Karin setting up some traffic cones to help the girls run drills.
lines.zh: 我去体育馆参加晨间足球训练，发现 Karin 正在摆锥形桶，好让女孩们做带球练习。

lines.en: Seeing as I'm here a bit earlier than normal and Karin has practically finished what she was doing already, the two of us get to talking for a little while.
lines.zh: 因为今天来得比平时早，而 Karin 手上的活儿基本已经干完了，我们俩就聊了一会儿。

lines.en: Well, trying to talk at least.
It's mostly just me saying things to her and her awkwardly fumbling to find responses that won't make her sound like she's terrified of males.
lines.zh: 基本就是我一个人在说，她笨拙地搜肠刮肚，想找出一些不至于让自己听起来很怕男人的回答。

lines.en: Of course, this doesn't work and within a matter of seconds, she is blushing furiously and struggling to even speak coherent words.
lines.zh: 当然，这招没用，没过几秒钟她就涨红了脸，连一句完整的话都说不利索。

lines.en: But, since I am so thoughtful and considerate, I do not point out her mistakes.
lines.zh: 不过，我这个人如此体贴入微，所以并没有指出她的错处。

lines.en: Instead, I just laugh silently to myself and think about how cute she is.
lines.zh: 我只是自己在心里偷笑，想着她有多可爱。

lines.en: And how excited I am to ultimately force her out of that shell of hers.
lines.zh: 还有我有多期待，最终把她从她那层壳里逼出来。

lines.en: I decide to get a move on once practice starts because I am a horrible excuse for a coach and an even worse excuse for a human.
lines.zh: 训练一开始我就决定撤了，毕竟我这个教练当得一塌糊涂，当人更是烂到家。

lines.en: But I got to talk to a beautiful girl with amazing thighs, so it was all worth it at the end of the day.
lines.zh: 但我跟一个腿型绝美的漂亮姑娘说了话，所以到头来还是很值。
